llm.summary: The skill is a coherent mymind connector, but its setup instructions include unverified remote installer commands that execute downloaded scripts directly.

dimensions.detail: Runtime tool access is limited to Bash(oo *), and the skill says credentials are injected server-side rather than handled as raw tokens, which is proportionate for a connector skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes curl-to-bash and PowerShell irm-to-iex installer commands from cli.oomol.com without version pinning or checksum/signature verification.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The broad 'ANY mymind request' trigger is mitigated by action-specific labels and instructions to confirm write and destructive actions before running them.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill does not define background workers, memory writes, services, or scheduled tasks. It does include one-time CLI installation and login/setup steps that create persistent local account/tool state when used.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is clear: operate mymind through OOMOL's oo CLI, including read, write, and delete operations. Those capabilities are disclosed and tied to listed mymind actions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the setup section before installing. Prefer installing the oo CLI through verified official releases or package-manager guidance, and do not run the pipe-to-shell commands unless you accept that they execute mutable remote code. For normal use, confirm exact payloads before write actions and explicit targets before destructive mymind actions.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: Validated in SKILL.md: the installer fallback directly executes remote scripts. This is not needed for normal connector runtime and creates supply-chain risk.
[SQP-1] expected: The skill does broadly route mymind work, including mutations, but the artifact explicitly lists write/destructive actions and requires user confirmation before those actions.
[T03] unexpected: Validated in SKILL.md lines 81-86: remote installer content is piped directly to shell interpreters without integrity verification.
